entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Sarah. How can I assist you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to make a return, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.
Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, could you tell me which item you're calling about?
It's the new Aero-Vent Pro jersey I ordered. I've been a loyal customer for years and was really looking forward to it.
I understand. And what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's the wrong size. I always order a medium, but this one is just way too tight across the chest. It's really uncomfortable. I was hoping for an exchange, but I don't see the large in stock online.
I see. Sizing can definitely be tricky sometimes. Let me pull up your account to check the policy for you. Can I have your name, please?
David Miller. It's just... with the exchange not being an option, I really needed this money back. Things are a bit tight right now.
Thank you, David. I have your order right here. I see the jersey was delivered 23 days ago. That's perfectly fine. Our standard apparel items, like this jersey, have a 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. I was so worried I had missed the window.
Not at all, you're well within the timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file.
Thank you, Sarah. I appreciate that.

Of course. And David, I see you're a VIP member with us and have been for quite some time. I'm very sorry we didn't have the right size for an exchange. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've added a $20 store credit to your account for your next purchase.
Wow, you really didn't have to do that. That's incredibly kind. Thank you so much, Sarah. That really makes a difference.
It's our pleasure. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Have a wonderful day, David.
